conbody.p: Warning message: Check Driver Assistance System
If there is a problem with the Parking Distance Warning or related functions and parts, a warning message is displayed on the cluster.

You can check the contents of the warning in the service message of the utility information view of the instrument cluster. If the function still does not work properly, have your vehicle inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.
